t: Sleep Tracker | Log Sleep & Dreams with a Four-Week Training Program
Track sleep and wake times, sleep quality, dreams, and caffeine with charts, average sleep duration, a journal, a four-week training program, local storage, and export/import.

Yes, you can track your sleep accurately and calmly with this app, designed for daily use in your browser with no account or server required. Log your bedtime and wake time to automatically calculate sleep duration, even when you fall asleep after midnight. Record sleep quality, dreams, caffeine intake, and notes to see how stimulants affect your sleep depth and continuity. The app displays your average sleep duration and charts of daily and weekly trends to help you understand fluctuations and choose more consistent times. It also includes an organized sleep journal for searching, filtering, and reviewing past entries with ease. Plus, there's a four-week self-training program with daily tasks and practical tips to establish regular sleep times, improve your evening routine, and gradually reduce caffeine. All your data is stored locally in your browser, with the option to export or import it as a file at any time.

Export and import work locally without any server.
Does the app require an account or a server?
No, it runs entirely locally in your browser. Your data is saved in local storage and is never sent to any server or account.
How is sleep duration calculated when falling asleep after midnight?
It is calculated automatically by adding 24 hours to the wake-up time if it is earlier than the bedtime, showing the correct duration for records that extend into the next day.
Can I review dreams and caffeine later?
Yes, dreams, notes, caffeine amount, and number of awakenings are saved in an organized log that can be searched, filtered, sorted, and reviewed at any time.
How does the chart display daily and weekly trends?
The chart displays recent selected records as bars for sleep duration with a line for sleep quality. It also shows average sleep duration and the last 7-day average to compare your progress.
Can I export or import data?
Yes, the export button displays a JSON copy that can be copied and saved to a file, and the import button accepts pasted text or a JSON file selected from your device to restore your data.
